description: Source code for radio operating standards management, including validation, setting, and updating radio standards and formats.

methods.name: _wld_rad_validateOperatingStandards_pvf
methods.description: Validates if a given operating standard value is allowed for a radio object.

methods.name: s_processOperatingStandards
methods.description: Processes and applies new operating standards to a radio object.

methods.name: wld_rad_handleOperStdsAndFormatNewValues
methods.description: Handles updates to operating standards and formats when their values change.

methods.name: wld_rad_update_operating_standard
methods.description: Sets the radio's operating standards to default if set to 'auto' and updates the data model.

methods.name: wld_rad_getEnabledRadStd
methods.description: Returns the enabled radio standards for a given radio, considering frequency band.

methods.name: wld_rad_checkEnabledRadStd
methods.description: Checks if a specific radio standard is enabled for a given radio.
